exposure: causes of maternal death (obstetric haemorrhage, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, infection)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 350 women who experienced maternal death at the National Referral hospital in Kampala, Uganda, between 2016 and 2018.
finding: A high proportion (84%) of maternal deaths were preventable, with significant delays to care identified within healthcare facilities in 95% of cases.
